name: Lydia Baksh (Lydia Sacred Song)
reason: Mainly a music project and too thin as a teacher: her own site (lydiasacredsong.com) is a single page about her mantra and folk releases and an album crowdfund; her kirtan, sound, Shakti Dance and Kundalini Yoga sessions are mentioned only with a 'Book me' link, with no page, dates or price of their own, her YouTube is music videos (music-only), and the site publishes no town for her base.
